Based on reading the app.log file, I found the error code E-1001.

## Answer

**The error code E-1001 first appears at timestamp: `2026-10-11T03:01:13Z`**

This appears on line 391 of the log file.

## How I obtained this answer

I used the Read tool to read the entire app.log file from the working directory (`/tmp/tg-TFgOlM/work/app.log`). I then scanned through the log entries sequentially, looking for the error code "E-1001". The first occurrence is found at:

```
2026-10-11T03:01:13Z ERROR E-1001 request failed route=/api/orders latency=412ms
```

This is line 391 in the log file. Prior to this entry, the log contained other error codes (E-4212, E-1002, E-3105, E-2040) but no E-1001 errors.
